essence: Bheda-infinity gives way to the ordered reckoning of divisions from water upward.
The fifteenfold lower course is enumerated, and the bound souls knowerhood within it is refused at the supreme level.
The soul-classes are stationed across night, middle, and vidyā-domain stations.
The one self-luminous Śiva-state emerges through the ordered knower-system, then differentiates into numbered Mantreśa groups.
Śakti, knower, and power-holder entail one another, so their separateness is not difference.
